## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] Tests added or updated, including a regression test for a bug fix
- [ ] Docs and the sample manifest updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] `make generate manifests` leaves no diff
- [ ] Breaking change? Added the `breaking-change` label and a release-note line
- [ ] I wrote or have the right to submit this code (see CONTRIBUTING)
